site.title: {project} - Decentralize File Sharin
site.description: {project} a wan peer-to-peer program fi share file dem, build pon modern decentralize technology.
site.ogDescription: Peer-to-peer file sharin build pon modern decentralize technology. No central server. No single point a failure.

hero.subtitle: Niex-generieshan peer-to-peer file sharin
hero.description: Build pon modern decentralize technology. No central server. No single point a failure.

about.title: Bout
about.intro: {project} a wan niex-generieshan platform fi peer-to-peer file sharin, build pon modern decentralize technology. It combine wan iizi-fi-yuuz interface wid wan whole-heap decentralize architecture, mek shuor file sharin sieful an reliable widoutn no need fi no central authority. Dis projek a open source, release anda di {license}.

decentralized.title: Whole-heap decentralize netwerk
decentralized.description: No central server, no single point a failure. Yuuza dem fain an dunglod content straait fram ada wan, widoutn dipen pon no central indeks, search engine, or database.

accessControl.title: Faina aksess control
accessControl.description: Anybadi kyaan bil dem owna netwerk wid dem owna ruul, fi free. Insaida iich netwerk, yuuza rool dem definn: owna, administrator, ediita, moderator, an follower. Yuh hav faina control ova wuh kyaan publish, moderate, an dunglod content.

ui.title: Hai-kuaaliti interface
ui.description: Wan klin an fiis media centa interface, dezain fi desktop, TV, an mobail platform dem. Iizi navigieshan wid kibood, mous, geempad, ar rimoot. Eksperinz yuuza kyaan ron di program lakka eddless server tru di kamand lain interface.

dataFormat.title: Yuuman-riedibl daata format
dataFormat.description: Di LISH daata format build pon JSON, mek it iizi fi miek, riid, an andastan. Shier yu content wid kliar an transparent metadata wuh anybadi kyaan verifai.

security.title: Praivisi an sekyuriti
security.description: Aal peer-to-peer komiunikieshan ina enkrip, mek shuor yu daata stie praivit ina transit. Yuuza kyaan haid biain wan VPN fi maks anonimiti. {project} rispek yu praivisi bai dezain.

crossPlatform.title: Kraas-platform
crossPlatform.description: Di program avaalibl fi Windows, Linux, an macOS. Yuuz it pon wichevva platform yuh prifa.

download.title: Dunglod
download.description: Get {project} fi yu platform. Aal dunglod fi free an open source.
